name: Spirit Level
author: buildwithnoknok
description: A digital spirit level for shelves, tables and 3D-printer beds. A third-party MSA311 accelerometer feels which way is down; the display shows a bubble and the tilt in degrees, the button LED is green when level. Press the button to call the surface zero. Third-party Qwiic / Stemma QT board: plug it in with the brain off.
assembly_guide: Unplug the PicoHub first: third-party boards are connected with the brain off.
Connect the Display, the LED Button and the MSA311 accelerometer to the PicoHub.
Lay the MSA311 flat on the surface (its component side up). Plug in the PicoHub and run setup in the noknok app.

controls.action: Moves towards the high side; the cross is level
Back to the board's own zero
Green = inside the tolerance, orange = tilted

controls.control: Hold a button or the knob while plugging in
controls.action: Factory reset - keep holding until the LEDs flash / the buzzer confirms (about 8 s)
